text: Stefan Parkman, born on 22 June 1952 in Uppsala, is a Swedish conductor. He serves as a professor at Uppsala University, holding the Eric Ericson chair of choral conducting. From 2002 to 2005, he was the head conductor of the Swedish Radio Choir, and he has also conducted the Danish Radio Choir and the Boys' Choir of Uppsala Cathedral. Since 1983, he has led Uppsala Akademiska Kammarkör. Parkman received the Danish Order of the Dannebrog in 1997 and was elected a member of the Royal Swedish Academy of Music in 1998.
